review:
Aztec Magic Deluxe is BGaming's revamped version of its original Aztec Magic slot, with redesigned graphics and sound but the same easy-going gameplay. It uses 5x3 reels with 15 paylines, an Aztec warrior as the wild and a sorceress princess as the scatter.

Three or more scatters anywhere award 10 free spins, which can be retriggered, and an optional card gamble is offered after any base-game win. What makes this game stand out is its maths: BGaming rates it low volatility, with free spins arriving roughly once every 70 spins on average, much more often than most modern slots. The RTP is a strong 96.96% and wins can reach 5,000x the bet. It's an excellent choice for longer, calmer demo sessions or for anyone new to slots.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 70 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
